panel_intro: Answer a few quick questions. The range updates as you go — nothing here is submitted anywhere.

storage_field.label: Days in storage
storage_field.help: Most lots start charging the same day or the next — even a partial day often counts as a full one.

select_fields.label: Where is it being stored?
select_fields.help: Private lots set their own rates; police/city impound rates are usually regulated.

select_fields.label: Vehicle type
select_fields.help: Bigger vehicles take up more space and often cost more to store.

toggle_fields.label: Releasing the vehicle outside normal business hours

factor_explanations.days: Storage is almost always billed per day, and most lots count any part of a day as a full day.
factor_explanations.lot_type: Private lots set their own daily rates, which can vary widely; police and city impound rates are usually set by local regulation.
factor_explanations.vehicle_size: Larger vehicles take up more space and are sometimes billed at a higher daily rate.
factor_explanations.after_hours_release: Many lots charge extra to release a vehicle outside normal business hours.

savings_tips: Retrieve the vehicle as soon as possible — every extra day adds to the bill.
Ask about the exact daily rate and any release or admin fee before you go, so there are no surprises.
If it's a private lot, ask whether the rate is capped by local law — some cities regulate maximum storage fees.
Bring exact payment methods accepted — some lots are cash-only or card-only, which can cost you another day if you show up unprepared.
common_mistakes: Assuming you can negotiate a lower daily rate at a regulated impound lot.
Waiting to retrieve the vehicle while fees keep accruing.
Not bringing proper ID or proof of ownership, causing a delay (and another day's fee).
Not asking about after-hours release fees before arriving outside business hours.
before_tow_checklist: Bring your ID and proof of ownership or registration.
Confirm accepted payment methods before you go.
Ask for an itemized bill covering the tow and every storage day.
Check the vehicle's condition before you leave the lot.

phone_script.intro: Read this while you're on the phone with the storage lot.
lines: Hi, I need to retrieve my vehicle that's been in storage.
Can you confirm the daily rate, total days, and any release or admin fee?
What forms of payment do you accept, and what are your release hours?
